# Qipu

> Public money, made legible. Qipu takes the data a city already publishes —
> budgets, contracts, grants, payroll, public works — and turns it into pages a
> resident can read, with every figure linked back to the file it came from.
> Three cities are live in three languages, alongside every French commune.

Independent project, open pipeline. Sources are official open data portals and
public accounts: Paris Open Data, DGFiP/OFGL, DECP (France), DataSF and the
Internet Archive (United States), Prefeitura do Recife (Brazil). Nothing here is
an estimate: each figure carries a link to the dataset row that produced it.

## Cities

- [Paris](https://www.qipu.org/): budget, grants, public contracts, investments,
  social housing, debt, and 182 places with the money that reached each.
- [San Francisco](https://www.qipu.org/us/city/sf): budget 2007–2027 and a timeline
  back to 1888, contracts, payroll, who the city pays, and 171 places with their
  archival record.
- [Recife](https://www.qipu.org/br/city/recife): orçamento, 7 912 contratos, quem
  recebe, and 1 068 lugares. In Portuguese.
- [Marseille](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/marseille): budget, places, work in
  progress.

## France, nationally

- [State budget](https://www.qipu.org/fr/national/budget): where national revenue
  comes from and where it goes.
- [Daily bread](https://www.qipu.org/fr/national/daily-bread): the same money seen
  per inhabitant, per day.
- [Debt](https://www.qipu.org/fr/national/dette) ·
  [Taxation](https://www.qipu.org/fr/national/fiscalite) ·
  [The State](https://www.qipu.org/fr/national/etat)
- **Every French commune** has a budget page at
  `https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/{commune-slug}` — 34 932 of them, built from the
  accounts published by the DGFiP and harmonised by the OFGL. Example:
  [Lille](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/lille).
- [Compare communes](https://www.qipu.org/comparer)

## Paris sections

- [Budget](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/budget) ·
  [Grants](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/subventions) ·

  [Social housing](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/logement) ·
  [Debt and assets](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/dette) ·
  [Places](https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/lieux)

## Entity pages

Every organisation, contract, supplier and place has its own page:

- `https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/lieu/{slug}` — a Paris place
- `https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/subventions/association/{name}` — a grant recipient
- `https://www.qipu.org/fr/city/paris/marches/contrat/{number}` — a Paris contract
- `https://www.qipu.org/us/city/sf/places/place/{slug}` — a San Francisco place
- `https://www.qipu.org/us/city/sf/who-gets-paid/payee/{slug}` — a San Francisco payee
- `https://www.qipu.org/us/city/sf/contracts/contract/{number}` — a San Francisco contract
- `https://www.qipu.org/br/city/recife/lugares/{slug}` — a Recife place
- `https://www.qipu.org/br/city/recife/quem-recebe/{cnpj}` — a Recife recipient

## Method and limits

- [Method](https://www.qipu.org/methode): how each figure is built, source by source.
- [Corrections](https://www.qipu.org/corrections): every correction, with its date
  and scope.
- [Analyses](https://www.qipu.org/analyses): written pieces.
- [For cities](https://www.qipu.org/pour-les-villes): what it takes to build this for
  another city.

Known limits, stated because they matter when citing this site: grants data for
Paris is missing 2020–2021; French procurement coverage depends on what each
authority declares to DECP; San Francisco's paid and agreed contract amounts
come from two different datasets and do not always reconcile; individual private
persons who receive grants are never named or indexed.
